intro: Codex runs in a sandboxed environment with controlled access to your filesystem and network — real work, safely bounded.

items.title: Launch from the right directory
items.body: Codex sees everything in the directory where you launched it and below. For monorepos, cd to the specific package before running Codex to scope it correctly.

items.title: Sensitive files
items.body: Codex will read .env and .env.local if they exist in the working directory. Keep real secrets in .env.local (gitignored). Use .env.example with dummy values for reference.

items.title: Resource limits
items.body: Commands timeout after ~30 seconds. Long test suites may need to be broken into parts. Output is truncated after ~10,000 chars per command.
